form.name: Image field layout -- Swiper + GLightbox
form.author: ggppdk
form.description: Flexicontent fields - Image field layout - Swiper + GLightbox parameters

field.name: PPFX_accent_color
field.label: Accent color
field.description: Theme color of the gallery: active pagination dot, progress bar fill and active thumbnail border. Navigation arrows keep their own color.

field.name: PPFX_nav_color
field.label: Navigation arrows color
field.description: Color of the previous/next navigation arrows. Leave empty to fall back to the accent color.

field.name: PPFX_slide_height
field.label: Carousel height
field.description: Controls the height of the carousel area. Leave empty to auto-size to image dimensions. Enter a number in pixels (e.g. 400) for a fixed height, or an aspect-ratio like 16/9 or 4/3 for a responsive height that scales with the container width. When set, images fill or fit the area according to the 'Image fit' option (fill/crop with 'Cover', whole and never enlarged with 'Contain'). When the 'Auto height' option is also enabled, a pixel value acts as a maximum height instead: smaller images keep their natural height, taller ones are capped.

field.name: PPFX_carousel_padding
field.label: Carousel padding
field.description: Padding applied inside the main carousel container, around the slides (and the overlaid pagination/arrows). Leave empty for no padding. Accepts a CSS padding value: a single value (e.g. 12px), two (10px 20px), or up to four (10px 12px 14px 16px), with any CSS length unit (px, em, rem, %).

field.name: PPFX_image_fit
field.label: Image fit
field.description: How each image fills its slide cell. 'Cover' forces the image to fill the whole cell, cropping or enlarging the overflow if the aspect ratios differ (default). 'Contain' shows the whole image without cropping and WITHOUT enlarging it: smaller images keep their natural size, centered in the cell; larger ones are scaled down to fit. NOTE: with an empty carousel height (auto-size mode) the two options look identical, because the cell grows to the image - selecting 'Contain' then gives the gallery a 16:9 display area automatically so the images are centered, like the Swiper demo. Applies to all transition effects and screen sizes.

field.name: PPFX_auto_height
field.label: Auto height
field.description: Dynamically adjust the carousel height to match the active slide content. Useful when slides have different aspect ratios. Works best with the 'Slide' or 'Fade' effect. NOTE: when a pixel 'Carousel height' is also set, it becomes a maximum - the carousel (and the images) never exceed it, smaller images keep their natural height.

field.name: PPFX_direction
field.label: Direction
field.description: Slide direction: horizontal (default, left/right navigation) or vertical (top/bottom navigation). Vertical mode works best with a fixed carousel height.

field.name: PPFX_effect
field.label: Transition effect
field.description: Visual transition effect between slides. 'Slide' is the classic sliding. 'Fade' crossfades between slides. 'Cube' gives a 3D cube rotation. 'Coverflow' mimics iTunes-style coverflow. 'Flip' flips the card. 'Cards' stacks slides like a deck. NOTE: Fade, Cube and Flip always display a single slide at a time (slides per view is forced to 1); 'Cards' still supports several slides per view (a visible stack behind the active card). The multi-row grid layout works with the 'Slide', the 'Fade' and the 'Flip' (each grid column transitions page by page), the 'Coverflow' effect (3D transforms per cell) and the 'Cards' effect (cells of stacked cards).

field.name: PPFX_slide_shadows
field.label: Slide shadows
field.description: Display a shadow under each slide for the 3D effects. Applies with the 'Cube', 'Flip', 'Coverflow' and 'Cards' effects; no effect with the other transitions.

field.name: PPFX_cube_shadow
field.label: Cube main shadow
field.description: Display the large blurred shadow below the cube. Only applies with the 'Cube' effect.

field.name: PPFX_flip_limit_rotation
field.label: Flip limit rotation
field.description: When enabled, the flip is constrained to a half-turn so the card turns cleanly over its edge. When disabled, the card can spin a full rotation. Only applies with the 'Flip' effect.

field.name: PPFX_cards_rotate
field.label: Cards rotate
field.description: Rotate each stacked card slightly so the deck fans out. When disabled, cards stack straight on top of each other. Only applies with the 'Cards' effect.

field.name: PPFX_cards_per_slide_offset
field.label: Cards offset (px)
field.description: Vertical offset in pixels between consecutive stacked cards. Higher values spread the deck more. Only applies with the 'Cards' effect.

field.name: PPFX_cards_per_slide_rotate
field.label: Cards rotation per slide (°)
field.description: Rotation angle in degrees applied to each consecutive stacked card. Only applies with the 'Cards' effect.

field.name: PPFX_coverflow_rotate
field.label: Coverflow rotate (°)
field.description: Angle in degrees to rotate non-active slides. 0 = no rotation, 50 = default coverflow rotation. Only applies with the 'Coverflow' effect.

field.name: PPFX_coverflow_stretch
field.label: Coverflow stretch (px)
field.description: Stretch gap in pixels between active and non-active slides. 0 = default, positive values increase spacing. Only applies with the 'Coverflow' effect.

field.name: PPFX_coverflow_depth
field.label: Coverflow depth (px)
field.description: Depth offset in pixels for non-active slides (3D perspective). Higher values push inactive slides further back. Only applies with the 'Coverflow' effect.

field.name: PPFX_coverflow_scale
field.label: Coverflow scale
field.description: Scale factor for non-active slides. 1 = same size as active, values < 1 make inactive slides smaller. Only applies with the 'Coverflow' effect.

field.name: PPFX_space_between
field.label: Space between slides (px)
field.description: Horizontal or vertical gap between slides in pixels. Only applies with the 'slide' effect.

field.name: PPFX_centered_slides
field.label: Center slides
field.description: Center the active slide in the viewport instead of aligning it to the left/top edge. Works best with slidesPerView > 1.

field.name: PPFX_slides_per_view
field.label: Slides per view
field.description: Number of slides visible simultaneously in the carousel. This is the main value and applies to all screen sizes. When responsive mode is on, this value applies to desktop screens (1200px and above), while the tablet and phone overrides apply to smaller screens. NOTE: this is the number of COLUMNS when combining with 'Grid rows'. The 'Fade' and 'Flip' effects always show a single slide (one column), so combine grid rows with the 'Slide', 'Coverflow' or 'Cards' effect for a real multi-column grid.

field.name: PPFX_slides_per_group
field.label: Slides per group
field.description: Number of slides to advance per swipe or click. Usually set this to the same value as 'Slides per view' so the carousel advances by a full page.

field.name: PPFX_grid_rows
field.label: Grid rows
field.description: Number of rows to display slides in. Set to 1 for a single row (standard carousel). Set to 2 or more to display slides in a grid layout. Each cell shows one image. Combine with 'Slides per view' to define columns. Works with the 'Slide', the 'Fade' and the 'Flip' (with Fade/Flip each grid column transitions page by page), the 'Coverflow' (3D transforms per cell) and the 'Cards' (cells of stacked cards) effects. Grid is disabled with the 'Cube' effect (which renders broken cells).

field.name: PPFX_grid_fill
field.label: Grid fill direction
field.description: How slides fill the grid cells. 'Row' fills each row left-to-right before moving to the next row. 'Column' fills each column top-to-bottom before moving to the next column.

field.name: PPFX_responsive_spv
field.label: Responsive slides per view
field.description: Use different numbers of visible slides on tablet and phone. When enabled, the base 'Slides per view' applies to desktop (1200px+), while the tablet and phone values override it on smaller screens. Breakpoints are fixed at 768px (phone/tablet) and 1200px (tablet/desktop).

field.name: PPFX_slides_per_view_tablet
field.label: Slides per view - tablet
field.description: Number of visible slides at widths of 768px to 1199px.

field.name: PPFX_slides_per_view_phone
field.label: Slides per view - phone
field.description: Number of visible slides at widths below 768px.

field.name: PPFX_speed
field.label: Transition duration (ms)
field.description: Slide transition animation duration in milliseconds. Lower = faster transition (e.g. 200), higher = slower (e.g. 600)

field.name: PPFX_loop_mode
field.label: Loop mode
field.description: When enabled, the carousel restarts from the first slide after the last one, and vice versa. Best used with navigation arrows or autoplay.

field.name: PPFX_rewind
field.label: Rewind
field.description: When enabled (and loop is off), clicking Next on the last slide rewinds to the first slide, and clicking Previous on the first slide jumps to the last. Provides a clear start/end point unlike loop.

field.name: PPFX_autoplay
field.label: Autoplay
field.description: Automatically advance to the next slide at a fixed interval. The delay can be configured below.

field.name: PPFX_autoplay_delay
field.label: Autoplay delay (ms)
field.description: Time in milliseconds between each automatic slide transition (e.g. 3000 = 3 seconds)

field.name: PPFX_show_nav
field.label: Show navigation arrows
field.description: Display previous/next arrow buttons to navigate between slides

field.name: PPFX_show_thumbs
field.label: Show thumbnail strip
field.description: Display a clickable thumbnail row below the main carousel for quick navigation between slides

field.name: PPFX_thumb_position
field.label: Thumbnail position
field.description: Position of the thumbnail strip relative to the main carousel. 'Left column' and 'Right column' display thumbnails as a vertical sidebar next to the carousel - a defined carousel height is recommended for best results.

field.name: PPFX_thumb_size
field.label: Thumbnail image size
field.description: Which image size to use for the thumbnail strip. 'Small' and 'Medium' are pre-generated thumbnails. 'Large' uses the lightbox-size image. 'Custom' uses phpThumb to generate a resized image on the fly (cached for 30 days).

field.name: PPFX_thumb_custom_size
field.label: Custom thumbnail width (px)
field.description: Width in pixels for phpThumb to generate the thumbnail. Height is calculated automatically to preserve aspect ratio. The resized image is cached on the server for 30 days.

field.name: PPFX_thumb_height
field.label: Thumbnail height (px)
field.description: Height in pixels of each thumbnail in the navigation strip. Width adjusts automatically to maintain aspect ratio.

field.name: PPFX_show_pagination
field.label: Show pagination
field.description: Display a navigation indicator showing the current slide. The rendering depends on the pagination type: dots, fraction counter or progress bar.

field.name: PPFX_pagination_type
field.label: Pagination type
field.description: Rendering style of the pagination. 'Dots' shows one bullet per slide. 'Fraction' shows a counter like 3/12. 'Progress bar' shows a fill bar that grows as you advance through the slides.

field.name: PPFX_pagination_fraction
field.label: Fraction format text
field.description: Layout of the fraction counter text. Use {current} for the current slide number and {total} for the total number of slides. E.g. 'Slide {current} of {total}'

field.name: PPFX_pagination_clickable
field.label: Clickable pagination
field.description: Allow clicking the pagination (dots, or the fraction counter) to jump directly to the corresponding slide

field.name: PPFX_pagination_dynamic
field.label: Dynamic bullets
field.description: Compact dots that reflect the active slide, useful when there are many slides. The number of visible dots adapts to proximity of the current slide. Only applies with the 'Dots' type.

field.name: PPFX_pagination_hideonclick
field.label: Hide pagination on click
field.description: Hide the pagination indicator when the user clicks on a slide, and show it again when the cursor moves

field.name: PPFX_show_scrollbar
field.label: Show scrollbar
field.description: Display a thin scrollbar-like progress track overlaid at the bottom (horizontal) or on the right side (vertical) of the carousel, showing and allowing to scrub through the slide position

field.name: PPFX_scrollbar_draggable
field.label: Draggable scrollbar
field.description: Allow dragging the scrollbar handle to navigate between slides

field.name: PPFX_scrollbar_hide
field.label: Auto-hide scrollbar
field.description: Hide the scrollbar automatically when the carousel is not being interacted with. Only applies when the scrollbar is draggable.

field.name: PPFX_scrollbar_drag_size
field.label: Scrollbar handle size (px)
field.description: Size of the draggable scrollbar handle in pixels (height for horizontal scrollbar, width for vertical). Leave empty for auto size, which scales with the number of slides.

field.name: PPFX_show_caption
field.label: Display caption in lightbox
field.description: Show the image title and description inside the GLightbox popup when clicking on a slide

field.name: PPFX_open_size
field.label: Image size opened in lightbox
field.description: Which resized image is loaded in the lightbox popup. 'Original' loads the full-size file (slower but best quality). Independent from the display size in the carousel.

field.name: PPFX_glightbox_loop
field.label: Lightbox loop
field.description: When enabled, navigating past the last image in the lightbox wraps back to the first one (and vice versa)

field.name: PPFX_desc_position
field.label: Caption position
field.description: Position of the title and description text inside the GLightbox popup

field.name: PPFX_grab_cursor
field.label: Grab cursor
field.description: Show a grab/move cursor on desktop when hovering the carousel, indicating the user can drag to navigate

field.name: PPFX_keyboard
field.label: Keyboard navigation
field.description: Allow navigating between slides using the left/right (or up/down for vertical) arrow keys on the keyboard

field.name: PPFX_mousewheel
field.label: Mousewheel navigation
field.description: Allow navigating between slides using the mouse wheel. Only triggers when the carousel is in the viewport.
